objective_summary.value: BASS-II aims to study the ignition, flame growth, flame spread, and extinction limits for solid fuels in low-velocity forced flows in microgravity. It bridges ground-based flammability tests with actual material flammability behavior in space.
objective_summary.quote: Study the ignition, flame growth, flame spread, and extinction limits for solid fuels burning in low-velocity forced flows in microgravity.

key_findings.value: In outer space, fuels burn as oval balls rather than with an upward pointed cone flame as they do on Earth.
key_findings.quote: In outer space, fuels burn as oval balls rather than with an upward pointed cone flame as they do on Earth.

earth_applications.value: Combustion models refined from space tests can be used to more accurately study flames on Earth, such as in wildfires, building fires, and energy recapture from waste recycling.
earth_applications.quote: These models can then be used to more accurately study flames on Earth, such as in wildfires, building fires, energy recapture from waste recycling, and other combustion problems.
